name: lg_race_lab32
doc: Stands in for saves/race_re/race_user.* (the owner's snes9x capture at Lab 32's west end, spliced over a base teleported to scene 223): Jackie's ch22 (storyline BD, party Crono / Lucca / Frog -- the capture's; its story bytes differ from the capture's in three flags, $7F00CD $7F00EC $7F01CF, none the race reads) brought to scene 223 (loc 0DF) at the capture's tile (43,6) facing up, Johnny (obj8) ahead, by the ROM's loader (`ct.exe --teleport 223 43 6 0`, 240 frames -- the capture's base's own teleport). $7F0054 bit 7 (the second meeting) and $7F0136 = 01 as the capture's: A at f30 -> CHANGELOC 10F f47, `FF 00` f66, the race's END f2877, 0DF f2913 -- the capture's frames.
